_doc: Curated gene classes from Green Listed's geneSets.json (human), mapped to the app's gene names. Built by scripts/build_gene_classes.py; do not edit by hand.

cancer.label: Cancer genes
cancer.description: Genes with an established role in cancer.

oncogene.label: Oncogenes
oncogene.description: Cancer genes OncoKB types as oncogenes (including those it also types as tumor suppressors).
oncogene.source: OncoKB Cancer Gene List, Gene Type

tsg.label: Tumor suppressors
tsg.description: Cancer genes OncoKB types as tumor suppressors (including those it also types as oncogenes).
tsg.source: OncoKB Cancer Gene List, Gene Type

kinase.label: Kinases
kinase.description: The protein kinome — serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinases.

phosphatase.label: Phosphatases
phosphatase.description: Protein phosphatases, the counterparts to the kinases.

tf.label: Transcription factors
tf.source: Lambert et al. 2018, The Human Transcription Factors

ddr.label: DNA damage response & repair
ddr.description: Repair enzymes plus the checkpoint and signalling layer — includes TP53, MDM2, CHEK2 and ATM.

surface.label: Cell surface
surface.description: Surface-exposed proteins — the fraction an antibody or CAR can actually reach, excluding lipid-anchored proteins that face the cytoplasm.

cd.label: CD markers
cd.description: Cluster-of-differentiation surface markers used to type and sort cells.

druggable.label: Druggable genome
druggable.description: Targets of an approved drug, plus those judged tractable to small molecules or biologics.

fda.label: FDA-approved drug targets
fda.description: Proteins targeted by a drug already approved for clinical use.

ionchannel.label: Ion channels
ionchannel.description: Ion channels — voltage-gated, ligand-gated and mechanosensitive.

transporter.label: Transporters
transporter.description: Solute carriers, ABC transporters and pumps.
